description: Rachel Moreno, a UX research lead in Portland, Oregon, and the people around her: her husband Tom, their daughter Lily, her mother Elena, her best friend Priya, colleagues, the plumber and the family beagle. The sources are four months of Rachel's conversations with her AI assistant (December 2025 to March 2026) and the documents she keeps: confirmation emails, school notices and her own notes. Everyone and everything in this case is invented.
